card.title: I Told You Enough
card.instruction: Agree to be honest while repeatedly narrowing what honesty requires and which details count.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll be honest about your missing donation box. You asked where I went; I said the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you take the box there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You didn't ask what was inside.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Was the money still in it when you arrived?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the car park, yes. If you mean the counter, that's a different arrival.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 confines honesty to destination; A3 answers box transport but excludes contents and A5 divides arrival into locations.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks about the box, producing A3 contents exclusion; B4 asks money at arrival, producing A5 car-park specificity.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 progressively target the actual missing-money concern, driving A's narrowing tactic.

heightening.evidence: B4 nearly pins down the money; A5 subdivides arrival itself to preserve an unanswered interval.

specificity.evidence: A1 missing donation box and bank, B4 money and A5 counter establish clear evidence and accountability stakes.
